responsibility: Collects the concrete MIR dataflow analyses built on the framework, especially initialization-state analyses over move paths. It defines and exports analyses for maybe/definitely/uninitialized places, ever-initialized paths, liveness, storage, and borrows, wiring them to `MoveData` and drop-flag effects for borrow checking and drop elaboration.
same_name_distinction: This `mod.rs` is the home of concrete dataflow analysis implementations such as initialized/uninitialized places, borrows, and storage liveness. It differs from `dataflow/framework/mod.rs`, which defines the generic engine API, and from `dataflow/move_paths/mod.rs`, which supplies the move-path model those analyses operate on.
